traits.d: The mule is considered to be a Large animal for the purpose of determining its carrying capacity.
The mule has advantage on Strength and Dexterity saving throws made against effects that would knock it prone.

actions.d: Melee Weapon Attack: +2 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. Hit: 4 (1d4 + 2) bludgeoning damage.

tips: Слабый спасбросок: Интеллект (-4) — эффекты и заклинания на эту характеристику с высокой вероятностью пройдут.
